newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise to 23 pct, liquidity lower.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise to 23 pct, liquidity lower.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates rose slightly on Thursday because tax payments reduced liquidity in the market, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 23.00 percent, up from Wednesday's finish of 22.50 percent.
"There is a little less liquidity than there was before," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank.
On the foreign exchange market, dealers were expecting the forint to slip somewhat against the dollar, opening at about 155.20/25 compared with Wednesday's close of 155.03/08.
